backend/main.mo: Actor manages contact inquiries, site content, and website ratings with admin authorization and timestamp-sorted queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two HeroSection UI changes to impacted files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing their functionality and recent feature updates.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode defaults, and global background/foreground rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point enabling dark mode, setting metadata, and loading the main React script with updated favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component handling hash-based routing for home, admin, and team pages and rendering main sections.
frontend/src/components/admin/SiteConten: Admin UI form allowing editing of hero, services, about, and contact site content via backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Screen shown on unauthorized admin access with login option and a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading states, error handling, and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders an About section with a heading, description, and a grid of feature cards highlighting service qualities. Includes styled background, a content card, and configurable text props.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Implements a contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and contact info display. Manages form state, errors, and submission status using custom hooks.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays a hero banner with video or fallback image, headings, and CTA buttons. Includes a modal system and demo numeric array generation for interaction elements.
frontend/src/components/sections/Ratings: Provides a ratings UI allowing users to submit star ratings and comments, displaying average rating and recent reviews. Integrates rating fetch and submission hooks with form validation.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a services grid with icons, descriptions, and images, each linking to contact action. Includes a ServiceCard component handling image loading and fallback states.
frontend/src/components/site/CookieConse: Displays a dismissible cookie/local-storage consent banner based on stored preference. Saves acceptance or decline to localStorage and hides once responded to.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: Footer component with logo lightbox trigger, quick navigation buttons, and social links using smooth scroll behavior.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx: Header component with logo lightbox, navigation links, and a mobile menu using a sheet drawer.
frontend/src/components/site/LogoLightbo: Modal lightbox displaying the company logo with escape key handling and body scroll lock.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports the public contact email and phone constants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactInquiry.ts: Empty placeholder file for contact inquiry hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useInquiries.ts: Empty placeholder file for inquiries-related hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, identity loading, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks for creating inquiries, fetching inquiries, and managing website ratings with parsing helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: Hooks for fetching and updating site content with fallback defaults and react-query caching.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, color variables, dark mode tokens, base styles, and custom animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Renders the admin dashboard with identity checks, admin validation, inquiry filtering, and site content editor UI.
frontend/src/pages/TeamPage.tsx: Displays a simple Team page highlighting the founder with a profile card and image.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, fonts, and plugins with custom oklch theme variables.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, branding notes, issues, and feature history for the ALGLOBE TECHNO SOLUTIONS site.
